notes: Corrections applied to workbook product rows at import time by apply-product-overrides.ts. Each entry records why the workbook value is wrong. An override that stops matching exactly one row, or whose `expect` values no longer hold, fails the import rather than silently doing nothing.

overrides.reason: EU-ME2 and EU-ME3 are both EVIS EUS Endoscopic Ultrasound Centers — the legacy and current generations of one Olympus platform. The workbook filed EU-ME2 under its own model number as the brand family and EU-ME3 under 'EVIS EUS', so the explorer showed them as two unrelated single-product lines instead of one platform with two generations.

set.product_name: EVIS EUS Endoscopic Ultrasound Center EU-ME2
set.notes: Legacy generation of the EVIS EUS platform; superseded by the EU-ME3.

overrides.reason: Named only 'Universal Endoscopic Ultrasound Center', which is indistinguishable from the EU-ME2 row once both sit in the EVIS EUS product line. The model number belongs in the product name so the two generations read apart on a card.

set.product_name: EVIS EUS Endoscopic Ultrasound Center EU-ME3
set.notes: Current generation of the EVIS EUS platform; successor to the EU-ME2.

overrides.reason: Filed under a bare 'Bronchoscopy platform' category with its own model number as the brand family and no dimensions at all, so it sat apart from the other EVIS EXERA III scopes and carried nothing a card could use. Specifications are from the Olympus America product page for the BF-H190; channel size cross-checks against the Olympus Bronchoscope Compatibility Chart.
